desc: 铺烤盘、垫托盘、折纸包入炉，一纸串起快手晚餐与甜点台
name: 家用多用途本色烘焙油纸卷款

shots.intent: 搜索列表里一眼看清盒型与品类，用干净横放盒身拿下首图点击。
用一条空白标尺位回应「一卷能铺多宽」，数值留白待后期合成。
shots.textZone: 产品上方居中空白标尺位，预留「{callout_1}」后期合成

shots.intent: 把铺盘入烤、端盘即上的一张晚餐场景演给买家，建立第一使用想象。
shots.textZone: 底部半透明横幅色带承载「{selling_point_1}」

shots.intent: 把同一张纸从烤架搬到待客桌面，用第二场景扩大使用人群。
shots.textZone: 底部半透明横幅色带承载「{selling_point_2}」

shots.intent: 用一处真实材质特写证明纸面平整、可折可撕，替代任何口头主张。
演示把纸折成纸包入炉的第三种用法，让一纸多用在最后一幕落地。
shots.textZone: 底部半透明横幅色带承载「{selling_point_3}」

shots.intent: 以晾置蘸糖的收尾画面把用途广度留给最后一眼，承接加购决策。
shots.textZone: 底部半透明横幅色带承载「{selling_point_4}」

style.backgroundSystem: seamless white studio sweep for packshots, one saturated cobalt gradient field for the spec screen, and real stone or walnut work surfaces for every use scene; backgrounds alternate shot to shot
style.direction: warm realistic kitchen-consumable commerce with a clean studio packshot front end
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in the accent hue only, no filled or 3D icons
style.lightingSystem: bright soft key with bounce fill on the packshots, warm directional daylight around 4800-5400K in the scenes, single light direction per frame, gentle contact shadows, no harsh speculars

noDrift: no invented numeric specifications rendered in-image
style.presentationRules: carton kept at identical scale and proportion wherever it appears; laid sheet always the same kraft tan tone #C6A16B; food never obscures the whole sheet; hands only as generic cropped supporting elements
style.surfaceSystem: cool light marble #F2EFEA for the baking scenes, dark walnut #4A2E1E with indigo linen for the serving and packet scenes, white marble #F4F1EC for the closing flat lay
